correctness.rationale: The rooted cluster variance polynomial follows from indicators along unique open s-v paths: V_s(p)=sum_{u,v}p^{(d(s,u)+d(s,v)+d(u,v))/2}-(sum_v p^{d(s,v)})^2. All seed differences factor p(1-p). Source check.py exhausts Prüfer codes for n<=7 and canonical unrooted shapes, then transforms Q by z/(1+z) and uses exact integer Descartes sign variations to rule out >1 crossings for n<=6; exactly three n7 representatives allow 2 signs and constitute two marked-pair isomorphism classes. Each exceptional witness has signs (-,+,-) or (+,-,+) at 0,1/2,1, giving exactly two distinct simple roots by IVT plus Descartes upper bound. Independent NetworkX tree enumeration and exact SymPy open-interval real-root checks reproduced 0 two-reversal pairs through n6 and exactly 3 representative pairs at n7. Independent 64-mask expectation expansion in source checks the displayed quartic. No larger-tree bound is asserted.
